metadata.question: Did Pittsburgh have its warmest February in 2018 (surface temperatures at 2 meters) compared to 2010 to 2017?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Use ERA5-Land hourly 2m air temperature (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY). Fallback: ERA5 hourly (ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY).
- Location: Pittsburgh, PA point buffered to 15 km region.
- Time: February for each year 2010–2018 (2010-02-01 to 2010-03-01, etc.).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Reanalysis data has no clouds; no masking needed.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection size; if 0, fallback then C1 if still 0.
- Compute monthly mean image and reduceRegion mean and count; if count==0 -> C2.
- If mean is null/NaN or outside [200, 330] K -> C3.
- Compare 2018 February mean to max of 2010–2017 means; strictly greater => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function getInfoAsync(eeObj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    eeObj.getInfo((v) => resolve(v), (e) => reject(e));
  });
}

async function febStatsForYear(year, region, primaryIC, fallbackIC) {
  const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 2, 1);
  const end = start.advance(1, 'month');
  let febCol = primaryIC.filterDate(start, end).select('temperature_2m');
  let size = await getInfoAsync(febCol.size());
  let source = 'ERA5-LAND';
  if (size === 0) {
    febCol = fallbackIC.filterDate(start, end).select('temperature_2m');
    size = await getInfoAsync(febCol.size());
    source = 'ERA5';
    if (size === 0) {
      return { year, status: 'C1' };
    }
  }
  const febMeanImg = febCol.mean();
  const meanDict = await getInfoAsync(
    febMeanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 9000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true,
    })
  );
  const countDict = await getInfoAsync(
    febMeanImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: region,
      scale: 9000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true,
    })
  );
  const meanK = meanDict ? meanDict['temperature_2m'] : null;
  const count = countDict ? countDict['temperature_2m'] : 0;

  if (!count || count === 0) return { year, status: 'C2' };
  if (meanK === null || meanK === undefined || Number.isNaN(meanK)) return { year, status: 'C3' };
  if (meanK < 200 || meanK > 330) return { year, status: 'C3' };

  return { year, meanK, count, source, status: 'OK' };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-79.9959, 40.4406]);
    const region = pt.buffer(15000); // ~15 km radius to capture multiple ERA5 grid cells
    const primaryIC = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/HOURLY');
    const fallbackIC = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5/HOURLY');

    // Quick availability checks (should be > 0)
    const quickSize = await getInfoAsync(primaryIC.filterDate('2010-02-01', '2019-03-01').size());
    if (quickSize === 0) {
      const fbSize = await getInfoAsync(fallbackIC.filterDate('2010-02-01', '2019-03-01').size());
      if (fbSize === 0) {
        console.log('No images found in primary or fallback dataset for 2010-2019 window.');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 2. Compute February means for 2010-2018
    const years = [2010,2011,2012,2013,2014,2015,2016,2017,2018];
    const results = [];
    for (const y of years) {
      const r = await febStatsForYear(y, region, primaryIC, fallbackIC);
      if (r.status !== 'OK') {
        console.log(`Year ${y} issue: ${r.status}`);
        console.log(r.status);
        return;
      }
      results.push(r);
    }

    // 3. Print concise evidence
    for (const r of results) {
      console.log(`${r.year} Feb mean K: ${r.meanK.toFixed(2)}, pixels: ${r.count}, src: ${r.source}`);
    }

    // 4. Compare 2018 vs 2010-2017
    const prior = results.filter(r => r.year < 2018);
    const priorMax = prior.reduce((acc, r) => (r.meanK > acc.meanK ? r : acc), prior[0]);
    const y2018 = results.find(r => r.year === 2018);

    // Validation range check again before final answer
    if (!priorMax || !y2018 || Number.isNaN(priorMax.meanK) || Number.isNaN(y2018.meanK)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (priorMax.meanK < 200 || priorMax.meanK > 330 || y2018.meanK < 200 || y2018.meanK > 330) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Warmest 2010-2017: ${priorMax.year} at ${priorMax.meanK.toFixed(2)} K`);
    console.log(`2018: ${y2018.meanK.toFixed(2)} K, Δ vs prior max: ${(y2018.meanK - priorMax.meanK).toFixed(2)} K`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    const isWarmest = y2018.meanK > priorMax.meanK; // strictly greater
    console.log(isWarmest ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('Error:', (err && err.message) ? err.message : String(err));
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
